concept.title: Reset an analysis
concept.shortdesc: Reset an analysis to start fresh.

conbody.p: Reset the analysis and start fresh by clicking Clear all. If you have edited the date/time filters and click Clear all, the button will perform its usual function and remove the zones, filters, and anything you input. If you have not edited the date/time filters but have removed all the zones, the button will be disabled, but the date/time filters will still be visible and editable.
